Hi Associates,

This is John from LAKKI LLC. I am trying to reach you regarding a job opening with us. If you would be interested in the below job description let us know your interest with updated resume.


Role: Manual QA
Location: Iselin, NJ.
Job type: Contract
Interview process: In-person
 
Roles & Responsibilities:
Mortgage domain- Home Mortgage experience and Whole sale Mortgage as well
Web application testing. Testing in Chrome, IE and mobile browsers
SQL and any programming language. Important
Ability to 'inspect elements' etc. during testing on browsers.
Testing concepts, test plans, test cases and test executions.
Ability to decipher test cases from requirements.
Take lead and initiative in testing. Should not be always waiting for instructions. Self-motivated and passionate.  Critical
Consultant has to be from NJ/NY/DE/MD/VA areas and commutable in car for screening.
